SEA_GLASS.THEINVENTOR-THE_INVENTOR.title: Encyclopedic Glass
THEINVENTOR-MANUAL.description: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]1[/blue] [red]less card[/red].
THEINVENTOR-MANUAL.title: The Manual
THEINVENTOR-BLUEPRINT.description: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]1[/blue] [red]less card[/red].
THEINVENTOR-BLUEPRINT.flavor: "I wonder if the rotating stage works similarly to this..."
THEINVENTOR-BLUEPRINT.title: The Blueprints
THEINVENTOR-CARDBOARD_HAT.flavor: "I can't believe the Merchant was just going to throw this away!"
THEINVENTOR-CARDBOARD_HAT.title: Cardboard Hat
THEINVENTOR-SPARE_SPECTACLES.description: One unupgraded card will always be offered as [gold]Scrap[/gold].
THEINVENTOR-SPARE_SPECTACLES.flavor: "Even comes with a case and cleaning cloth!"
THEINVENTOR-SPARE_SPECTACLES.title: Spare Spectacles
THEINVENTOR-PORTABLE_FAN.description: Whenever you create a card in combat, apply a random debuff to ALL enemies.
THEINVENTOR-PORTABLE_FAN.flavor: "God paper pulp smells awful. At least now I'm not the one smelling it."
THEINVENTOR-PORTABLE_FAN.title: Portable Fan
THEINVENTOR-TOASTED_MARSHMALLOW.descript: At the end of your turn, gain 2 block per {Energy:energyIcons()} remaining.
THEINVENTOR-TOASTED_MARSHMALLOW.flavor: "...I don't want to talk about this one."
THEINVENTOR-TOASTED_MARSHMALLOW.title: Toasted Marshmallow
THEINVENTOR-ELECTRICAL_GLOVES.flavor: "Not only does this protect my hands, the abrasive texture means I won't keep dropping my stuff!"
THEINVENTOR-ELECTRICAL_GLOVES.title: Electrical Gloves
THEINVENTOR-CLOSED_TOE_SHOES.description: At the start of combat, [gold]Enchant[/gold] a card in hand with [pink]Swift[/pink] [blue]3[/blue].
THEINVENTOR-CLOSED_TOE_SHOES.flavor: "If I rotate my shoes out after each combat, I might be able to keep my socks dry!"
THEINVENTOR-CLOSED_TOE_SHOES.title: Closed Toe Shoes
THEINVENTOR-TOOLBELT.description: [gold]Unplayable[/gold] cards can now be played. Playing an [gold]Unplayable[/gold] card [gold]Blinks[/gold] it.
THEINVENTOR-TOOLBELT.flavor: "You can never have too many pockets, and a toolbelt is just pockets!"
THEINVENTOR-TOOLBELT.title: Toolbelt
